section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section presents a theoretical framework for understanding body appreciation and eating disorders through the lens of social rank theory and sociometer theory. The authors discuss how social safeness, self-reassurance, and body appreciation relate to eating psychopathology, and state that their study aims to test an integrative model exploring whether the relationship between social safeness and body appreciation with eating-related psychopathology is mediated through self-reassurance while controlling for BMI. No specific study details, sample characteristics, or methodological information are provided in this introduction.
